captions.caption: A black title card with white text details the MV-22 Osprey Fast Rope exercise.
The title card provides information about the joint exercise Cobra Gold in Thailand.
Text on the title card describes the commitment of several nations to regional security.
The screen displays credits for the imagery by Lance Cpl. Jacob A. Hug.
Contact information for the visual professional and releasing authority is shown.
The informational title card remains visible on the screen.
The screen continues to display the exercise and military unit details.
The title card provides a summary of the events at Hat Yao Royal Thai Naval Base.
The final moments of the informational text are displayed before the video starts.
An MV-22 Osprey sits on a concrete helipad with its rotors spinning.
The Osprey's rear ramp is open as it prepares for takeoff in a grassy field.
The aircraft remains stationary on the ground with its large propellers rotating.
The MV-22 Osprey's engines are running as it readies for its flight demonstration.
A rear view of the Osprey shows the cargo area and spinning tilt-rotors.
The Osprey's rotors create a visible blur as they increase speed for lift.
The aircraft sits ready on the pad with hills and trees in the background.
The MV-22 Osprey starts to vibrate as it begins its vertical ascent.
The aircraft begins to lift off the concrete surface of the landing zone.
The MV-22 Osprey takes off vertically from the helipad into the air.
The Osprey gains altitude, leaving the ground as it moves upwards.
The aircraft continues its ascent, moving away from the camera's position.
A military observer on the ground watches the Osprey climb into the sky.
The Osprey rises higher above the trees and bushes surrounding the pad.
The aircraft transitions into forward flight as it gains more height.
The MV-22 Osprey flies away from the landing area towards the horizon.
The aircraft becomes a smaller shape against the bright, overcast sky.
The MV-22 Osprey is seen as a distant silhouette flying through the air.
The aircraft maintains its flight path across the wide, grey sky.
A far-off view shows the Osprey maneuvering in the distance.
The Osprey continues its demonstration flight at a high altitude.
The aircraft turns slightly, visible as a small dot in the distance.
The MV-22 Osprey moves across the sky, far from the observer's location.
The aircraft's tilt-rotor configuration is barely visible from this distance.
The Osprey continues to fly through the hazy, overcast sky.
The aircraft begins a turn to head back toward the camera.
The MV-22 Osprey approaches from the distance, flying directly towards the viewer.
The aircraft grows larger in the frame as it flies closer at a low altitude.
The Osprey's twin rotors are clearly visible as it nears the camera.
The aircraft continues its steady approach, flying low over the landscape.
The front of the Osprey is centered as it flies directly at the camera.
The aircraft maintains a constant heading and altitude during its approach.
The MV-22 Osprey is now close enough to see details of its fuselage.
The aircraft's landing gear is extended as it prepares for a landing maneuver.
The Osprey fills the screen as it flies just above the camera's position.
The aircraft passes directly overhead with its rotors in vertical flight mode.
The underside of the Osprey is visible as it zooms past the camera.
The aircraft moves past the camera, showing its tail and rear section.
The Osprey flies away from the camera after its close pass.
The aircraft is seen from behind as it continues its flight path.
The Osprey maneuvers in the air, heading towards a hilly area.
The aircraft begins to turn as it flies over the green terrain.
The MV-22 Osprey flies at a low altitude, parallel to a dirt road.
The aircraft slows down and begins to hover above the ground.
The powerful rotors kick up a massive cloud of dust from the dry earth.
The Osprey is partially obscured by the dust it generates while hovering.
The aircraft moves slowly forward through the thick dust cloud.
The Osprey continues its low-level flight, creating more dust on the ground.
The aircraft is seen flying low through the hazy conditions it created.
The MV-22 Osprey maintains its hover-taxi over the dusty terrain.
The aircraft continues to move slowly, surrounded by a swirl of dust.
